verdict.rationale: Cloudflare publishes an explicit at-cost, no-markup commitment: you pay only what registries and ICANN charge, and renewals happen at the registry list price. That satisfies the 'published low-margin guarantee' branch. However, nothing in the evidence shows a visible per-domain breakdown of registry versus ICANN fees. Community reports of higher .io and new-gTLD prices than at other registrars are explained by other registrars negotiating better registry deals, so they do not concretely contradict the at-cost claim. Missing for 10: a visible registry/ICANN fee breakdown per TLD, and independent verification that charged prices equal registry wholesale.

support.subject: As a power user, pricing is at or near wholesale — at-cost claims backed by visible registry fee breakdowns or a published low-margin guarantee

citations.quote: Buy and renew domains through Cloudflare Registrar at cost, without markup fees. You only pay what is charged by registries and ICANN.
your domain will only renew at the list price set by the registry.
See registration, transfer, and renewal prices upfront, with no hidden fees or required add-ons.
